params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 pre-orders are beating Take-Two's expectations On Take-Two's latest earnings call, CEO Strauss Zelnick said Grand Theft Auto 6 pre-orders are tracking far above expectations. He added that the game will "set a new baseline" for the company and that the numbers will soon speak for themselves. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 01:02 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer #GTA6 #TakeTwo #GamingNews
